text:
The City owned solid waste disposal grounds, located on Singleton Road adjacent to Coyote Creek, serves as a local collection point for the dumping of rubbish. A compactor compacts and spreads wastes which are covered every other day. The 14 acre site serves communities in Santa Clara County and the southeastern portion of San Jose. The disposal grounds presently receive approximately 40 tons of waste per day.
Fire Protection and Police Service
The Fire Department organization is comprised of four bureaus with approximately 600 full-time positions. These positions are allocated to fire stations within the City on a basis of 3.32 positions per duty station. Fire protection facilities consist of twenty-five stations in four fire districts plus training, maintenance and administration facilities.
Police patrol services are performed by the Bureau of Field Operations, largest of four Police Department bureaus. Of the 907 positions in the Department, 353 are devoted to the police patrol activity utilizing 132 radio-equipped patrol vehicles. The City is divided into seven police districts and forty beats.
